column1: # Altin Peak: the miner's condition after the rescue.

column3: I thought the roof would\ncome down again. I can't\nstop shaking.{end_wait}
He's in shock. Give him\na moment before asking\nanything else.{end_wait}
The others are waiting\noutside. He's hurt, but\nhe's not alone.{end_wait}
Stay with him until\nhe's ready to leave?{end_now}
Thank you. I need a\nmoment before I can walk.{end_wait}
The mine is still unstable.\nWe can't stay here. Let's\nget everyone to safety.{end_wait}
